correctness.rationale: The same-loop and cross-loop geodesic tails are independently derived by arclength integration; the exact positive-part formula is continuous at thresholds. Differentiating along every unequalizing two-petal transfer yields nonnegative pair and third-petal contributions; majorization transfer decomposition gives the full ordering. Strictness holds on a nonempty threshold interval for every distinct multiset. Exact rational tests of 21420 transfer/threshold triples and independent spatial quadrature corroborate, but do not substitute for the analytic proof.
